create_atomicdata_from_ase_atoms: create an AtomicData graph object from an ASE Atoms object with optional neighbor search and energy forces
convert_atomicdata_to_ase_atoms: convert a single-graph AtomicData object back to an ASE Atoms object with calculator results
create_atomicdata_from_dict: create an AtomicData object from a Python dictionary containing required tensor keys like pos and atomic_numbers
batch_atomicdata_list: batch a list of single-graph AtomicData objects into one batched AtomicData object for model inference
extract_single_graph_from_batch: extract a single AtomicData graph at a given index from a batched AtomicData object
